g.text: Does the summary change the evidence?

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #bd784d

g.text: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY · Simulated data · No measured platform performance

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #81778c

g.text: An accurate summary sits on the diagonal. Systematic departures reveal distortion.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #675d74

g.text: Each point is one hypothetical rated claim (240 total). The diagonal means exact reporting.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #675d74

g.text: The right panel separates error direction and spread, so a mean near zero cannot hide large mistakes.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #81778c

g.text: DESIGN SIMULATION — NOT RESULTS. Contours show 50% / 90% of smoothed illustrative density, not statistical uncertainty.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #81778c

g.text: Agreement percentages and error patterns are simulated; no actual consultation ratings enter this figure.
